verdict.rationale: n8n documents a public REST API (n8n-docs-16) that is widely known to support workflow CRUD and activation, and the docs site is machine-readable (n8n-probe-1). However, the evidence pack gives no detail on specific create/update/activate endpoints or agent-driven usage examples, and attempts to locate a discoverable OpenAPI spec all returned 404 (n8n-probe-2), weakening confirmation of full programmatic coverage. missing for 10: explicit endpoint documentation for workflow create/update/activate, a working OpenAPI/swagger spec, and hands-on/community evidence of an agent successfully driving the API end-to-end.
